mapper.select: SELECT r.RE_NUM AS reNum, r.USER_ID AS userId, r.QNA_NO AS qnaNo, r.PARENT_RE_NUM AS parentReNum, r.RE_CTT AS reCtt, TO_CHAR(r.RE_CREATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reCreate, TO_CHAR(r.RE_UPDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reUpdate, NVL(UPPER(u.ROLE), 'USER') AS writerRole, u.USER_NAME AS writerName FROM REPLY r LEFT JOIN USERS u ON u.USER_ID = r.USER_ID WHERE r.QNA_NO = #{value} ORDER BY NVL(r.PARENT_RE_NUM, r.RE_NUM) ASC, r.RE_NUM ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE REPLY SET RE_CTT = CASE WHEN RE_CTT LIKE '[ADMIN_DELETED]%' THEN RE_CTT ELSE '[ADMIN_DELETED] ' || TRIM(REGEXP_REPLACE(RE_CTT, '^\[(ADMIN_DELETED|ADMIN_EDITED|USER_REEDIT)\]\s*', '' )) END, RE_UPDATE = SYSDATE WHERE RE_NUM = #{value}
UPDATE REPLY SET RE_CTT = #{reCtt}, RE_UPDATE = SYSDATE WHERE RE_NUM = #{reNum} AND RE_CTT NOT LIKE '[ADMIN_EDITED]%' AND RE_CTT NOT LIKE '[ADMIN_DELETED]%'
UPDATE REPLY SET RE_CTT = '[ADMIN_EDITED] ' || #{reCtt}, RE_UPDATE = SYSDATE WHERE RE_NUM = #{reNum}
